{"task": {"id": "I_kwDOVMdNDs8AAAABZgy0LA", "item_id": "PVTI_lAHOAHSLSM4BnXy5zhDH3Eg", "project_id": "PVT_kwHOAHSLSM4BnXy5", "number": 39, "title": "Resolve recurring morph-only loop acceptance failures with playback and rendered-frame evidence", "body": "## Problem

The morph-only Demo loop assertion intermittently fails, leaving mandatory playback acceptance unresolved. [Historical merged CI](https://github.com/takahirox/mmd-gltf/actions/runs/40028584888/job/120670877106) timed out after five seconds at `tests/browser/vmd.spec.ts:204`: expected time below `0.5`, observed `0.9416000000000933`. [Later PR-head CI](https://github.com/takahirox/mmd-gltf/actions/runs/40036644031/job/120697650482) passed 63 Node and 24 browser tests, with two optional skips. Neither result identifies the historical cause.

## Expected outcome

Resolve the demonstrated acceptance problem using bounded evidence that distinguishes player updates, clock scheduling, polling and rendered output. Correct any demonstrated playback defect; if playback is correct, fix the observation method while preserving actual looping and rendering requirements.

Keep changes within the existing player, Demo, focused regressions and documentation. Preserve converter/plugin contracts and existing numerical, raster and lifecycle acceptance. VMD, VPD, remaining morph families, ordered IK/append, physics and representative fidelity remain mandatory overall work.

## Context

At baseline `b85a15bf6ab2dee2cd20054a925e92e23efe6402`, `VMDPlayer.update()` wraps positive-duration looping playback using modulo. The Demo supplies elapsed `performance.now()` time through its real animation callback. The failing test seeks to `0.99`, starts playback and polls instantaneous time. The bone-motion lifecycle test uses a similar observation.

[Playwright 1.56.1 source](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/microsoft/playwright/v1.56.1/packages/playwright/src/matchers/expect.ts) uses default polling intervals of 100, 250, 500 and then 1000 milliseconds. Sampling a periodic state can miss its short acceptance window; this is a supported hypothesis, not a proven diagnosis of the historical run.

Retained assumption correction: the prior AI-authored acceptance assumed polling `time < 0.5` reliably demonstrated wrapping. Corrected requirement: establish an actual duration crossing and its resulting evaluated/rendered state using evidence scoped to the active model and motion. The polling source and repository modulo implementation explain why instantaneous sampling is insufficient.

Reuse the existing post-render revision acknowledgement and held-animation-frame regression pattern. [Official Three.js source](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mrdoob/three.js/r186/src/renderers/common/Renderer.js) shows initialized `render()` invokes scene rendering; returning is not evidence of GPU completion, so retain canvas evidence. [Core glTF](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/KhronosGroup/glTF/main/specification/2.0/Specification.adoc) defines sampler endpoint clamping; preserve the repository's separate playback policy without inventing MMD semantics.

## Pre-merge acceptance

- [ ] Record a bounded diagnostic trace containing rig/source/motion identity, duration, before/after player time, supplied delta, playing/loop state and matching rendered revision/frame. Explain observed evidence and unresolved historical uncertainty. Reproduce the failure or demonstrate the suspected observation failure under controlled scheduling.
- [ ] Add focused Node coverage for morph-only wrapping through the real player, including exact-duration and multiple-duration advances, unchanged original-rest bones, independently predicted weights, pause and non-loop endpoint behavior. Retain existing bone-motion lifecycle coverage.
- [ ] Replace fragile transient-window observations with durable evidence of an actual crossing. Cover both existing Demo rigs and the morph-only GLB reproducer; preserve existing combined-motion bytes/GLB/glTF coverage.
- [ ] Exercise the real Demo callback under controlled delayed frames. Require correct elapsed-time wrapping, continued playback and evaluated weights, then capture a matching rendered state and canvas. Demonstrate that held rendering or stalled playback cannot satisfy the corresponding acceptance.
- [ ] Keep evidence isolated across reload, motion/model replacement, reset and VPD handoff. Preserve both existing VPD poses, manual-weight ownership and disposal coverage.
- [ ] Preserve timeouts, numerical/raster thresholds and scenario coverage. Do not substitute retries, skips, timeout inflation, slowed production playback or synthetic UI updates for working acceptance.
- [ ] The Coordinator records final-source results from existing tooling: `npm run build`, `npm run typecheck`, `npm test`, `PLAYWRIGHT_CHROMIUM_CHANNEL=chromium npm run test:browser`, `npm run check:links` and `git diff --check`. Distinguish passing, failed, skipped and unperformed checks. Existing matching CI evidence may supply results; this evaluation adds no independent re-review or generic rerun.
- [ ] Update the validation record with provenance, bounded traces, diagnosis, correction and remaining limits. Any further correction of AI-authored requirements retains the old assumption, corrected requirement, primary evidence and rationale; no human approval or independent AI re-review is required. Preserve the overall goal and justified acceptance.

## Optional validation

An additional naturally scheduled slow-frame trace may supplement the controlled regression. Do not repeat runs until green or claim original-MMD equivalence.

## Required post-merge verification

None required.

## Specification reconciliation

This task was authored by AI under the agreed MMD/glTF model, VMD animation and
VPD pose reproduction goal. Correct erroneous technical assumptions or acceptance
criteria when primary specifications or measured evidence establish the correction.
Update this Issue and record the original
assumption, corrected requirement, primary reference and rationale in the PR.
These technical corrections require neither human approval nor an independent AI
re-review. Preserve the agreed goal and relevant pre-merge acceptance; do not weaken
requirements merely to accommodate incomplete implementation or failing tests.
